# Drain blockage inspection

**DOCUMENT ID:** D001

**ORGANIZATION:** Fictional Civicly Demo City

**VERSION:** 1
**EFFECTIVE FROM:** 2026-09-01

## Procedure / lesson

Before recommending drain cleaning, verify upstream inlet and downstream segment; log debris depth, flow direction, source, photos and date. Do not infer obstruction from nearby litter alone.

These are invented demonstration records and do not claim to be official policies of any real municipality.
